newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-L.Lease to raise A$325 mln in float.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-L.Lease to raise A$325 mln in float.

text.p: Lend Lease Corp Ltd said on Thursday it would raise A$325 million from the public share offer of the Darling Park project, a property development project in Sydney's central business district.
Lend Lease said A$1.0 billion Darling Park project involved the development of commercial offices and retail outlets.

It said the funds raised from the offer would be used to acquire a 50 percent stake in the existing 27 story IBM Tower at Darling Park and fund a 50 percent involvement in the development of stage two of the Darling Park project.
The fund raising would occur in two tranches and involve the issue of 130 million units at A$2.50 each, it said.
Unitholders would pay A$1.00 per unit on application, raising an initial A$130 million with final installments of A$1.50 due on December 31, 1999 to raise a further A$195 million, it said.

Lend Lease said the issue was to be underwritten by Ord Minnett and would open on November 11 and closes on December 5 and trading is expected to start on the Australian Stock Exchnage by December 18.
It said there would be a priority allocation to its shareholders.
